sentences.en: There are signs of growing tensions between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 两国之间出现紧张关系的迹象。

sentences.en: The photo catches the tension in the court very well.
sentences.zh: 这张照片很好地捕捉到了法庭上的紧张气氛。

sentences.en: In Thailand, tension is high ahead of tomorrow's general election.
sentences.zh: 泰国明天将举行大选，目前局势非常紧张。
